jobs.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Medical Information, EMEA
jobs.description: Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn. Summary of Position: The Senior Manager, Medical Information, EMEA will be responsible for developing, managing, and delivering high-quality, accurate, and compliant medical information content to support unsolicited requests from healthcare professionals. Based in Europe and operating within a global matrix, this individual will ensure timely and accurate responses are being provided to healthcare professionals in response to their inquiries. This role necessitates a comprehensive understanding of medical information with a strong emphasis on project management, medical writing, and strategic thinking. Position Responsibilities Create custom responses to address escalated requests from the European Medical Information Call Center in addition to supporting the development of responses at the global level. Ensure call center agents are equipped with up-to-date scientific content and trained to respond accurately and professionally to HCP inquiries. Monitor and analyze inquiry trends and insights to inform scientific communications

jobs.title: Reflexology Therapist
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Memberikan pelayanan massage dan reflexology kepada customer sesuai SOP perusahaan. Melakukan treatment dengan teknik yang telah ditentukan dan memperhatikan kenyamanan serta kebutuhan customer. Menjaga kebersihan, kerapihan, dan kesiapan area treatment sebelum dan sesudah digunakan. Memberikan pelayanan yang ramah, sopan, dan profesional kepada setiap customer. Mengikuti training, evaluasi, dan pengembangan skill yang diberikan perusahaan. Mematuhi SOP, standar grooming, kedisiplinan, serta peraturan perusahaan. Kualifikasi: Wanita dan pria sehat jasmani dan rohani. Memiliki minat bekerja di bidang massage, reflexology, wellness, dan pelayanan. Pengalaman sebagai therapist menjadi nilai tambah. Fresh graduate/non-pengalaman dipersilakan melamar karena akan diberikan training. Bersedia mengikuti masa training dan probation. Jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan memiliki attitude yang baik. Ramah dan mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift. Bersedia bekerja pada weekend dan hari libur sesuai jadwal. Berpenampilan bersih dan rapi. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Benefit: Gaji pokok. Uang transport. Bonus/insentif. Training dan pengembangan skill. Kesempatan pengembangan karier. Lingkungan kerja profesional di bidang wellness.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Access
jobs.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. Key Responsibilities Vendor Management Serve as the primary point of contact for all external vendors collaborating with myTomorrows within the Global Access function. Support procurement efforts during vendor RFP processes, including requirements scoping, proposal evaluation, selection, and contracting. Collaborate with the quality and legal team during vendor onboarding and ongoing maintenance, ensuring all documentation, SOPs, and compliance records are accurate and up to date. Conduct structured regular check-ins with vendors to monitor performance, track program milestones, and resolve operational issues in a timely manner. jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.
